Method of Attack: Ransomware encryptor that uses DLL sideloading vulnerabilities in legitimate Trend Micro, BitDefender, and Cortex XDR executables to load a malicious DLL injector
Injects ransomware payload 'config.ini' into Notepad process to encrypt files
Discoverer: Chile’s Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT)
Impacted Systems: Grupo GTD's Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) platform
Public services in Chile using GTD's IaaS
Attack Vector: DLL sideloading vulnerabilities in Trend Micro AirSupport (u.exe)
DLL sideloading vulnerabilities in BitDefender Update Downloader (d.exe)
